## Decisions

## D-01 Freed and recruited Shadowheart (S002)
- Choice: opened her pod with the Eldritch Rune (willed it open via the tadpole, WIS DC 2) and accepted her into the party
- Why: a cleric healer/support fills the party's biggest gap
- Consequence: she joined; quest "Rescue the Illithids' Captive" completed [seen S002]
- Consequence: she's wary of Lae'zel ("dangerous company") and disputes Lae'zel's leadership [seen S002]
- Reversible: no

## D-02 Lae'zel's cage: sided with the tieflings by mistake (S007)
- Choice: [Paladin] Deception "leave it to me" crit-failed (nat 1), then picked Persuasion "Shoot the trap down, we must kill it"
- Why: misread it as a way to free her; not reloaded (it would only reroll the checks)
- Consequence: journal "convinced the tieflings to help us kill Lae'zel", then "We left Lae'zel to her fate" (a regroup moved Claude away); the tieflings died, Lae'zel gone [seen S007]
- Expected later: she might still be met and recruited [guess]
- Reversible: unknown

## D-03 Recruited Wyll; swore Nettie's oath; saved Arabella (S009)
- Choice: Wyll joined on "cure this infection, partner up" (no promise to kill Karlach) [seen S009]
- Choice: swore to Nettie to drink the Wyvern Toxin if I start transforming; told her the truth (mind flayer ship) [seen S009]
- Choice: talked Kagha into freeing Arabella ("your snake is prepared to kill this child"); urged Rolan's siblings to stay ("where the weak have need...") [seen S009]
- Why: the Devotion paladin's oath (protect the innocent, honesty); avoids a fight with the druids
- Consequence: Save Arabella done (Komira's Locket); Gale approved x3; quest "Rescue the Druid Halsin" [seen S009]
- Reversible: no

## D-04 Used the tadpole on the goblin ambush in the Blighted Village (S013)
- Choice: Shadowheart's "Stand down. Now." through the parasite's Authority (WIS, advantage, passed)
- Why: avoid an ambush fight with little session time and few spell slots left
- Consequence: the goblins took us for True Souls and let us pass; quest "Embrace Your Potential" added [seen S013]
- Expected later: more tadpole use pushes toward the illithid path; some companions may disapprove [wiki]
- Reversible: no

## D-08 Fought the windmill goblins, freed Barcus; took Olak's war paint (S015)
- Choice: killed Fezzerk (the rest left combat), braked the windmill, freed Barcus Wroot without asking a reward [seen S015]
- Choice: at Olak's checkpoint, after a failed Deception, accepted the worg-dung War Paint instead of fighting [seen S015]
- Why: help the innocent (Devotion oath), and keep the goblin camp neutral for the Halsin rescue
- Consequence: entered the camp and the Sanctum peacefully; goblins are neutral [seen S015]
- Reversible: no

## D-09 Killed the three goblin leaders; sided with the Grove (S017-S018)
- Choice: killed Priestess Gut (S017), Dror Ragzlin and Minthara (S018) instead of raiding the Grove [seen S018]
- Why: Devotion oath; save the tieflings and druids; Halsin's help with the tadpole
- Consequence: the whole goblin camp turned hostile; we cleared the outer camp and the Sanctum entrance [seen S018]
- Consequence: the tieflings celebrated at camp, then left for Baldur's Gate; Halsin joined our camp [seen S018]
- Consequence: Minthara is dead (not knocked out), so she can't be recruited later [wiki]
- Reversible: no

## D-10 Refused the refugees' coin; chose the Underdark route; resisted Gut's tadpole (S018)
- Choice: told Zevlor to keep the collection [seen S018]
- Choice: Underdark route to Moonrise Towers (Halsin: via the temple of Selûne) [told S018]
- Choice: Shadowheart resisted absorbing Gut's tadpole (passed STR check) [seen S018]
- Why: Devotion oath; Nettie's promise; avoid the shadow curse
- Reversible: tadpole powers can still be taken later [wiki]

## D-11 Recruited Karlach, killed Anders' group; Wyll-Karlach truce; refused Raphael (S021)
- Choice: Karlach joined (Wyll swapped to camp); we killed Anders, Trynn, Cyrel (Zariel's agents) at the tollhouse [seen S021]
- Choice: at camp, sided with Karlach peacefully; Wyll agreed to a truce [seen S021]
- Choice: refused Raphael's soul deal for the tadpole cure ("I serve an oath") [seen S021]
- Why: Devotion oath; Karlach is a victim of Zariel, not an agent; never sell the soul
- Consequence: Gale and Karlach approved; Raphael says he'll return when luck runs out [told S021]
- Reversible: Raphael's offer stays open [told S021]

## D-12 Switched to the Mountain Pass route (S021)
- Choice: dropped the Underdark route (Priestess Quarters door untargetable by the tools) for Risen Road → Waukeen's Rest → Mountain Pass [seen S021]
- Why: harness can't open that door; Halsin named both routes [told S018]
- Reversible: yes

## D-13 Left the Wilderness for the Rosymorn Monastery Trail; Gale and Mizora choices (S023)
- Choice: abandoned Florrick (never found; Rescue the Grand Duke closed "didn't find him") [seen S023]
- Choice: with Mizora, told her not to touch Karlach; Wyll was turned into a devil anyway [seen S023]
- Choice: killed Baretha's githyanki patrol (Lae'zel had died to them); reloaded once after a near-wipe [seen S023]
- Choice: confirmed the Mountain Pass exit → Trail (auto-resolves Grove-era quests; Rescue Volo left open) [seen S023]
- Choice: Elminster/Mystra's charge for Gale: "we'll find another way" (not the self-sacrifice) [seen S023]
- Choice: refused Lady Esther's githyanki-egg job (traded only) [seen S023]
- Why: main quest toward Moonrise; Devotion oath (protect the innocent, no child theft)
- Reversible: the Wilderness waypoints still work [guess]; Act 2 not entered yet [seen S023]

## D-14 Declined Lady Esther's egg job; kept the Shadow-Cursed exit for later (S023)
- Choice: asked Esther to trade instead of taking her githyanki-egg job; did not take the Shadow-Cursed Lands exit at L4 [seen S023]
- Why: get XP first; Crèche/Monastery still ahead on the trail
- Consequence: quest not taken; gold 946 after selling spare armour [seen S023]
- Reversible: yes (can return) [guess]

## D-15 Zaith'isk, Crèche lies, entered Act 2 with Kar'niss's convoy (S024)
- Choice: Claude used the zaith'isk (WIS fail → -2 WIS; zaith'isk destroyed, tadpole lives) [seen S024]; crit-failed a Deception to Ghustil → killed Ghustil + 6 githyanki in the infirmary [seen S024]
- Choice: told Kith'rak Therezzyn we knew nothing of the "weapon" (Astral Prism = our artefact), Deception passed [seen S024]
- Choice: took the Shadow-Cursed Lands exit at L5 (Act 1 leftovers abandoned: Volo, blue jay, Blood of Lathander) [seen S024]
- Choice: revealed ourselves to Kar'niss as True Souls and joined his convoy under the Moonlantern instead of fighting [seen S024]
- Why: XP/L5 before Act 2; keep the artefact; avoid a 128-HP drider fight; the convoy light protects from the curse
- Reversible: Act 1 regions can still be revisited until the Gauntlet of Shar [wiki]

## D-16 Moonrise as a True Soul: Mizora deal, spared the goblins, took Z'rell's relic quest (S025)
- Choice: Intimidated Mizora (18 vs DC14): she will amend Wyll's pact after we free Zariel's asset [seen S025]
- Choice: asked Ketheric to spare the goblins, then ordered "Guards, release them" (Drenn was killed anyway) [seen S025]; Karlach approved
- Choice: failed Deception to Z'rell (13 vs 16) about the goblins; still got Find Ketheric Thorm's Relic [seen S025]
- Choice: took a Moonlantern from Balthazar's chambers (Z'rell later told us to) [seen S025]
- Why: stay undercover to learn Ketheric's invulnerability (the Nightsong [wiki]); the Moonlantern frees us from the convoy
- Consequence: Z'rell distrusts us a little [guess]; Raphael asked us to kill his old enemy below the Mausoleum [seen S025]
- Reversible: yes so far

## D-17 Allied with Jaheira, saved Isobel, refused the tadpole absorption (S025)
- Choice: told Jaheira we will destroy the Absolute at Moonrise; she allied [seen S025]
- Choice: reloaded a lost Isobel fight; won with Marcus dead, Isobel alive [seen S025]
- Choice: closed our mind to the Dream Visitor's offer to absorb the True Soul tadpole [seen S025]
- Choice: promised Mattis/Ide/Umi to bring Mol home; told Mattis we'd return for the key [seen S025]
- Why: Devotion oath; protect the innocent; unsure of the illithid path (Claude -2 WIS)
- Reversible: the absorption offer stays open [guess]

## D-18 Bought the Tower-Shaped Key; fought Malus Thorm; oath broken; told Arabella (S026)
- Choice: paid Mattis 1000g for the Tower-Shaped Key (Masons' Guild basement) [seen S026]
- Choice: forced past Sister Sinda and fought Malus Thorm after failed DC21 Persuasion [seen S026]
- Consequence: Confused Claude cast Silence and read the Scroll of Cloudkill; the Distressed Patient died → Oath Broken [seen S026]
- Choice: no reload (a game outcome); plan to pay the Oathbreaker Knight 1000g [wiki]
- Choice: promised Arabella to find her parents; told her at camp they are dead [seen S026]
- Why: Karlach's heart; Devotion honesty; follow the journal
- Reversible: the oath can be restored for gold [wiki]
- Outcome: paid the Oathbreaker Knight 1000g at camp; Oath of Devotion restored [seen S026]

## D-19 Moonrise prison breakout; Claude's oath broken again (S028)
- Choice: fought the prison guards after being caught talking to Wulbren (Keris, the Warden, 3 Zealots died) [seen S028]
- Consequence: Claude's crossbow killed the 'Temporarily Hostile' Warden → Oath Broken; restore now costs 2000g [seen S028]
- Choice: gave Wulbren a Crude Mace, said 'It's time', sailed everyone to Last Light [seen S028]
- Choice: did not pay to restore the oath yet (gold 597 then, 1158 now) [seen S028]
- Why: free the prisoners before they were taken; no reload for a game outcome
- Outcome: Rescue the Tieflings / Wulbren / Rolan all done, rewards from Rolan and Alfira [seen S028]

## D-20 Spear of Night for Shadowheart; oath restored; Karlach's heart (S037)
- Choice: inserted the Nightsinger book at the Riddle of the Night, took the Spear of Night + Dark Justiciar Helmet; Shadowheart wears both [seen S037]
- Choice: paid 2000g to the Oathbreaker Knight; Oath of Devotion restored (gold 60 left) [seen S037]
- Choice: gave Dammon the last Infernal Iron; Karlach has touch back; she must return to Avernus or burn up [told S037]
- Choice: did NOT enter the Shadowfell yet (point of no return for Act 1 areas) [wiki]; Verge waypoint unlocked [seen S037]
- Why: keep Shadowheart (refusing the Spear makes her leave [wiki]); Devotion is Claude's build

## D-21 Took Jaheira along for the roof; she died in the Moonrise Prison (S043)
- Choice: persuaded Jaheira to leave the main floor and come with us [seen S043]
- Consequence: wrong stairs led to the optional prison fight; Jaheira died; Revivify spell and scroll failed, so she's gone [seen S043]
- Why: wiki says she helps on the roof vs Ketheric; the loss came from the party trailing behind her

## D-22 Killed Ketheric (Aylin alive); refused Thisobald's drink and killed him (S046)
- Choice: finished the Ketheric/Apostle fight with Aylin saved; told the Dream Visitor we'd seek allies in the city [seen S046]
- Choice: refused Thisobald Thorm's Blackfire at the Waning Moon → he and his zombies attacked; all killed [seen S046]
- Why: Ketheric was Act 2's goal; drinking unknown cursed brew looked riskier than the fight

## D-23 Accepted Orin's deal for Gale; Aelis talked down; Volo lost (S050)
- Choice: reloaded S049-sarevok-dead after the Aelis grease near-wipe; then persuaded Aelis (DC18) [seen S050]
- Choice: accepted Orin's deal: kill Gortash, bring his Netherstone, then duel her; Gale (kidnapped) lives meanwhile [seen S050]
- Choice: at the Foundry, defied Volo's executioners ("where's the trial") → fight; Volo died, not revivable [seen S050]
- Why: Gortash's stone is needed anyway; entering her temple first would get Gale killed [told S050]

## D-24 Zanner destroyed the Foundry, ordered by Wyll; refused the Bhaal cult (S055)
- Choice: Claude's own "Do it" to Zanner gave Oath Broken → reloaded S055-titan-dead; Wyll gave the same answer and Claude's oath stayed intact [seen S055]
- Consequence: Steel Watch disabled, Foundry destroyed, Zanner alive (left to gather the Gondians) [seen S055]
- Choice: refused Reaper Clotilde's invitation to slaughter citizens "in Orin's favour" → fight [seen S055]
- Why: a third oath break would cost 10,000 gp to restore (2 breaks before) [wiki]; Devotion protects innocents

## Archive

- S067: Fought Orin after passing Persuasion (option 3) so Gale lived; killed Orin, took her Netherstone, freed Gale with the Altar Key. Why: Gale's life + the last Netherstone [seen S067].

## D-xx Wyll broke his pact with Mizora; Ravengard stays dead (S068)
- Choice: "Break the pact, Wyll. You deserve your freedom." over reviving the Duke for Wyll's eternal soul-pact with Zariel [seen S068]
- Why: a Devotion paladin won't trade a friend's soul to an archdevil; Karlach objected to Zariel taking him. Mizora stays in camp (ally for the final fight) [seen S068]
- S069: Gale read the Annals of Karsus (plans to reforge the Crown). Claude urged him to drop it ("destined for greatness, not Karsus' shadow"); he seemed to accept. Why: Devotion paladin, godhood ambition = danger to Gale and the world. Then Elminster appeared: Mystra summons Gale to the Stormshore Tabernacle; Claude: "you should meet her" [seen]
- S077: Killed Cazador Szarr in his sarcophagus ("Kill Cazador"); no Astarion in the party, so the ritual was neither completed nor taken over. [seen S077]

## D-40 Shadowheart's parents released (S083)
- Choice: "Talk to your parents" → "This is your choice, Shadowheart"; she released Arnell and Emmeline to Selûne at their request; her curse (Shar's scar) is lifted; she keeps the name Shadowheart [seen S083]
- Why: it was the parents' own clear wish and her decision to make; Devotion: compassion, not overruling her
- S085: Killed Minsc (Stone Lord) in the Cistern: Jaheira is dead so he couldn't be recruited [wiki]. Sided with Nine-Fingers' Guild against the Zhentarim ("I'm with you"): Guild joins the final battle [seen S085].

## D-S086 Skipped House of Hope; entered the Morphic Pool; will side with the Emperor (S086)
- Choice: no House of Hope/Mol's contract (Free Orpheus quest never started); boarded the Skiff (point of no return) [seen S086]
- Plan: give the Netherstones to the Emperor; without the Orphic Hammer, spurning it forces Raphael's soul contract or a game over [wiki]
- Consequence: side quests closed as abandoned (Hope, Helsik, Florrick...) [seen S086]
- Reversible: no
- S087: Gave the Netherstones to the Emperor in the Astral Prism; it assimilated Orpheus (irreversible). Why: planned in S086; no Orphic Hammer, refusing Raphael. [seen S087]
